head: Stress Less app now on iPad with encrypted iCloud sync
dek: Stress Less, an app that gives you a short stress relief card to try in about a minute, now works on iPad in version 2.7. Max subscribers can sync their check-ins between iPhone and iPad through end-to-end encrypted iCloud backup.
details: After each card the app asks if it helped and shows helpful cards more often. Cards come in four groups: Body, Mind, Rest and Kindness. The app is free with ads; Stress Less Max, monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase, adds sync, no ads and insights from Apple's on-device AI. There's no account, and check-ins stay on your device unless you turn on iCloud. The developer is 1ManStartup LLC.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, free with Stress Less Max
means: If you already use Stress Less on iPhone, your history can now follow you to an iPad.
todo: Install it on your iPad and tap Continue with iCloud; reminders need to be set on each device.
